data.name: Rugged Northerner
data.description: You live a hard life in a cold climate and gain some benefit from it. Frostbite, hypothermia, and extreme cold effects lessened. You live a hard life in a cold climate and gain some benefit from it. You treat extreme cold conditions as severe cold, and severe cold as cold weather conditions. You are not impacted at all by normal cold weather conditions. In addition, you do not become fatigued by frostbite or hypothermia.
